<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Helper function to determine if <span class="doxyComputerOutput">CB</span> is an aligned (GPU) barrier.</p>


<p>---------------------— NoSync <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/function">Function</a> <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/attribute">Attribute</a> ----------------------—</p>


<p>Aligned barriers have to be executed by all threads. The flag <span class="doxyComputerOutput">ExecutedAligned</span> indicates if the call is executed by all threads in a (thread) block in an aligned way. If that is the case, non-aligned barriers are effectively aligned barriers.</p>
